--- alter_sequence_skip_restart.sql
ALTER SEQUENCE S SKIP RANGE 1, 2 RESTART COUNTER WITH 3

--- AST
&ast.AlterSequence{
  SequenceEnd: 55,
  Name:        &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 15,
        NameEnd: 16,
        Name:    "S",
      },
    },
  },
  RestartCounterWith: &ast.RestartCounterWith{
    Restart: 33,
    Counter: &ast.IntLiteral{
      ValuePos: 54,
      ValueEnd: 55,
      Base:     10,
      Value:    "3",
    },
  },
  SkipRange: &ast.SkipRange{
    Skip: 17,
    Min:  &ast.IntLiteral{
      ValuePos: 28,
      ValueEnd: 29,
      Base:     10,
      Value:    "1",
    },
    Max: &ast.IntLiteral{
      ValuePos: 31,
      ValueEnd: 32,
      Base:     10,
      Value:    "2",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
ALTER SEQUENCE S RESTART COUNTER WITH 3 SKIP RANGE 1, 2
